confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or current rates. Priced in USD, which Phnom Penh tourist prices are normally quoted in, although the riel is the official currency. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain and may run lower in the July rainy season. Cocktail and wine anchors follow the beer anchor (about 2.75x and 3x) because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general price levels for Southeast Asian capitals and tourist cities that quote hotels and many restaurant prices in USD.
